item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Optimize agents from insights in Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Optimization from insights is now in public preview in Foundry Agent Service. From an eligible prompt-agent trace in the Foundry portal, users can generate and evaluate candidate changes to an agent’s instructions and function-calling tool descriptions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Native A2A passthrough for hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Agent Service now supports native A2A passthrough for hosted agents in public preview, letting existing Agent2Agent agents connect without a protocol conversion layer. Incoming A2A requests are forwarded directly instead of being converted to the Responses protocol.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Central governance of hosted-agent outbound domains in Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Azure Policy can now govern outbound destinations for hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service. Agent authors must attach a compliant egress policy before creating an agent version, and that policy controls outbound requests.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: ai: Hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service at Ignite 2026: from pilot to production inside your enterprise boundaries
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry Agent Service added enterprise-focused hosted agent capabilities at Ignite 2026, including shared subnet IPs, private CA trust, network egress controls, deployment to customer-managed AKS clusters, resilient execution, and memory snapshots.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: ai: What’s new in Foundry Agent Service at Ignite 2026
item.description:
Microsoft announces Ignite 2026 updates for Foundry Agent Service, focused on making agents more reliable in production by improving context handling, tool use, runtime resilience, and iterative improvement.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Foundry Routines in Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Foundry Agent Service now includes Foundry Routines in public preview. This adds a native trigger primitive so published agents can run automatically on schedules or in response to business events.

  • Source: Azure Updates
